name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2022 in Intrusions (ICS)
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK for ICS techniques from the 2022 record: the ids that CISA advisory AA22-103A on the ICS attack tools names in the study, Mandiant's report on the October 2022 Sandworm attack on a Ukrainian power company, and campaign C0034. Revoked ids are shown under their v20.0 successors. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2022.md. Scores: 100 an opened source or ATT&CK object prints the id.
